pages.title: Role in Progression
pages.text: Qi Refining cultivators can learn introductory methods, basic Five-Element spells, low-tier talismans, movement and escape arts, and a few mortal martial skills. These currently serve as rules data for future method learning, sect inheritance, quest rewards, and spiritual-root affinity bonuses.

pages.title: General and Support Arts
pages.text: Qi-Guiding Art: prerequisite for all cultivation methods and techniques.$(br)Sound Transmission: private communication over several li.$(br)Object Control: retrieve and manipulate objects at range.$(br)Heavenly Eye: observe spiritual power and pierce simple illusions.$(br)Concealment and Invisibility: tools for stealth and escape.

pages.title: Five-Element Offense and Control
pages.text: Spark and Firebolt are introductory fire attacks. Freeze is a low-cost water/ice attack; Entangling Vines is a wood restraint; Earth Spike and Quicksand attack and trap with earth. A Soul-Stilling Talisman briefly immobilizes the spirit and is especially effective against low-tier demon beasts.

pages.title: Movement and Martial Skills
pages.text: Levitation grants brief flight, while Wind-Riding Art is faster and more agile. Turtle Breathing Art supports feigned death and concealment; Luo Mist Steps bursts over short distances; Blink Swordplay exploits visual misdirection; Elephant Armor Art strengthens bodily defense; and Snow-Wind Swordplay slows foes with freezing sword qi.
